subject: DECISION NEEDED: retroactive XP backfill for 50 labs that were mis-typed as presentations
description: Commit 74e6ea0ad added type:'lab' to 50 CloudMaster labs that were awarding 100 XP (presentation rate) instead of 500 (LAB_COMPLETE), and were absent from house.labsCompleted / progress.labsCompleted. VERIFIED MECHANISM: XPCalculator.recalculate() classifies each completed module via _resolveType(id, quizIds, labIds), where labIds is built from the stored labsCompleted array. So the fix is NOT retroactive -- a student who completed one of these 50 labs BEFORE the fix still has that module absent from labsCompleted, so it keeps resolving as a presentation and keeps paying 100 XP forever unless they complete it again. Nancy flagged this as a separate decision from the code fix, correctly: backfilling means a production Firestore migration that moves already-completed lab IDs into labsCompleted for affected users, which is a CLAUDE.md rule-10 production write requiring explicit operator authorization in chat. OPTIONS: (1) do nothing -- affected students keep the lower award unless they revisit; (2) backfill migration -- needs a user-scope decision (all users? only those with any of the 50 IDs?), a dry-run count, and a backup first; (3) announce and let students re-complete. NOT started; awaiting Frank.
